title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
author: J. K. Rowling
summary: In his third year, Harry returns to school as an escaped prisoner supposedly hunting him roams free and eerie guards patrol the grounds. Meanwhile, he learns more about his parents and a past that involves his family.
readIf: you want a mystery-flavoured entry with a darker tone and more depth than the first two books.
skipIf: you haven't read the earlier books, as it assumes you know who's who and relies on the history.

pairings.reason: The next book, which expands the world and raises the stakes further.
A classic with time-bending ideas and a young hero facing a looming darkness.
Another children's fantasy that treats young readers as capable of big ideas and real danger.
